scope: Real msProbe 26.1 debug tensor save records, original dtype bytes, canonical native producer/consumer identity and mapped TP2 outputs. Not automatic API-hook dump or independent ACLNN kernel tracing.
limitations: Recorded msProbe producer source hashes are pinned; file format alone is not cryptographic producer attestation.
Reference rounding may differ on real peer activations; only replaced target calibration is a strict gate.
Per-rank local TP feature range only; no artificial multiplier or added cross-rank maximum.
A logits or token change is not an objective answer error; no full-answer quality claim is made by this capture verifier.

observer_transparency.scope: Independent msprobe-OFF B still uses the canonical native observer. B/H full logical input/prefix contracts, all nine original-dtype tensors (input, native/returned/reference Q and scale, local consumer contribution, first logits), complete returned prompt/output IDs, text, finish reason and top-5 logprobs are equal. This bounded observation does not prove absence of all global instrumentation side effects.
